note: Latin letters that aren't a base letter plus an accent, so decomposing a word doesn't take their mark off. 'folds' is what each reads as without diacritics (ł as l, ß as ss, þ as th), applied before the marks are dropped; İ is here because lower-casing leaves it. 'secondForms' is a second spelling some languages write for a letter, read as another form of the word as well as the folded one: German ü ö ä as ue oe ae, Danish and Norwegian ø as oe and å as aa, Serbian and Croatian đ as dj. Keys are single lower-case letters as the normaliser leaves them.
